Record.skills_indicators: Executive Order, Quarterly Self-Audit, Focal Team, Leadership Direction
Record.narrative_quote: We realized that cramming two weeks before the DILG table assessment always led to failed indicators. I issued an Executive Order mandating quarterly self-audits and designated permanent focal persons in every department.

Record.subtheme: Continuation of practices outside formal assessment cycle
Record.skills_indicators: Visible Service Delivery, Year-Round Implementation, Community Impact
Record.narrative_quote: For us, passing SGLG is just a consequence of good governance. What truly matters is that our 24/7 disaster operation center and computerized procurement operate continuously even without an impending assessment.

Record.skills_indicators: Focal Persons, Interdepartmental Coordination, Monitoring Committee, Shared Drive
Record.narrative_quote: Before, SGLG was seen as solely the MPDC's problem. When we created the interdepartmental monitoring committee with monthly tracking meetings, every department head became accountable for their own governance area.

Record.subtheme: Documentation and records management, staffing turnover
Record.skills_indicators: Records Management, Documentation Backlog, Staffing Shortages, Turnover
Record.narrative_quote: Our biggest barrier was not lack of political will, but records management and staff turnover. When job order encoders left, the institutional memory vanished, leading to delays and documentary deficiencies.

Record.skills_indicators: DILG Technical Assistance, DILG Coaching, Pre-Assessment, Technical Clarification
Record.narrative_quote: The DILG coaching sessions and mock table evaluations helped the LGU identify compliance gaps early, providing technical clarification on newly revised SGLG financial administration guidelines.

Record.skills_indicators: Local Ordinances, Standard Operating Procedures, SOPs, Year-Round Monitoring
Record.narrative_quote: The strongest evidence of institutionalization was not the volume of documentation prepared for assessment, but the continuation of governance practices as part of regular administrative and service-delivery routines.

Record.subtheme: Concrete changes in policy, process, or practice
Record.skills_indicators: Leadership Commitment, Accountability Arrangements, Administrative Reform
Record.narrative_quote: Following our previous assessment gaps in disaster risk reduction, we restructured the MDRRMO into a full department with dedicated plantilla positions and institutional accountability.

Record.skills_indicators: Shared Documentation, Information Systems, Escalation of Unresolved Issues
Record.narrative_quote: We migrated all procurement records and posting requirements to a centralized shared information system so that focal persons can review compliance status in real-time.

Record.skills_indicators: Budget Constraints, Limited Resources, Technical Expertise, Last-Minute Compliance
Record.narrative_quote: Being a 4th-class municipality, budget constraints and lack of technical expertise in formulating early warning systems caused severe delays during our initial SGLG compliance rush.

Record.skills_indicators: Institutional Memory, Standard Operating Procedures, SOPs, Routine Governance
Record.narrative_quote: We codified our child and gender development programs into municipal standard operating procedures and ordinances so that services continue uninterrupted even during mayoral transitions.

Record.subtheme: Feedback, coaching, and recurring capacity gaps
Record.skills_indicators: DILG Support, Feedback, Technical Clarification, Capacity Building
Record.narrative_quote: While DILG technical assistance provided timely coaching and feedback, recurring documentation problems persisted in engineering due to lack of licensed building inspectors.

Record.subtheme: Sustained resource allocation and visible service delivery
Record.skills_indicators: Beyond Paper Compliance, Sustained Resource Allocation, Visible Service Delivery
Record.narrative_quote: Our materials recovery facility and sanitary landfill operations remain fully staffed and funded year-round because environmental compliance is seen as public health protection, not paper compliance.

Record.skills_indicators: Sustainable Governance, Embedded Accountability, Outside Assessment Cycle
Record.narrative_quote: Across cases, sustainable SGLG performance was distinguished from documentary compliance by the extent to which governance practices were institutionalized, owned by responsible offices, continuously monitored, and maintained outside the formal assessment cycle.

Record.skills_indicators: Documentation Backlog, Technical Capacity, Records Management, Inter-Office Delays
Record.narrative_quote: Reconciling revenue audit trails between the treasury and accounting suffered from inter-office delays and manual records management, resulting in last-minute compliance cramming.

Record.subtheme: Escalation of unresolved issues and institutional accountability
Record.skills_indicators: Escalation Mechanism, Institutional Accountability, Department Heads
Record.narrative_quote: When department focal persons encounter bottlenecks in submitting documentary evidence, the issue is immediately escalated to the monthly executive coordination meeting presided over by the Mayor.

Record.subtheme: Routine reports and continuation of practices
Record.skills_indicators: Routine Reports, Year-Round Monitoring, SOPs, Continuation of Practices
Record.narrative_quote: Infrastructure project monitoring reports and accessibility compliance are updated bi-monthly as a routine standard operating procedure, not solely when the SGLG national validation team arrives.

Record.skills_indicators: DILG Technical Assistance, Pre-Assessment, Coaching, Capacity Gaps
Record.narrative_quote: DILG technical assistance acts as a key enabling mechanism through orientation and pre-assessment diagnostics, but internal LGU capacity dictates how effectively corrective actions are institutionalized.

Record.subtheme: Learning from previous assessment gaps, policy changes
Record.skills_indicators: Governance Transformation, Concrete Changes in Policy, Learning from Gaps, Ordinances
Record.narrative_quote: Learning from our past assessment failure in local legislation transparency, the Sanggunian enacted landmark ordinances digitizing legislative records and establishing strict accountability arrangements.
